posts.title: Why is the Ogre there?
posts.description: Joe's post on the Quantum Ogre raises an old question about sandbox play: when does moving an encounter around interfere with players' freedom to decide what their characters do? I agree with a lot of what he says, especially that information matters. In my Living World Sandbox, I stress the importance of the Initial Context. Where I disagree is that players' choices matter.
